sloka: तस्य त्वम् कुरु वै कार्यम् पूर्वम् तेन कृतम् तव ।हरीश्वर हरि श्रेष्ठान् आज्ञापयितुम् अर्हसि ॥४-२९-१८॥
transliteration: tasya tvam kuru vai kāryam pūrvam tena kṛtam tava ।harīśvara hari śreṣṭhān ājñāpayitum arhasi ॥4-29-18॥

translations.english: 'Rama is responsible in lending stability to you and to your wellknown family. He will continue to be your ally for a long time. Let it be known that his power is boundless and his virtues peerless.
translations.hindi: भीरामचन्द्र जी तुम्हारे कुल की वृद्धि करने वाले हैं, तुम्हारे घड़े मित्र दे, वे बढ़े प्रभाव वाले हैं और गुणों में सब के ऊपर हैं
